title: On the Howe--Moore property for automorphism groups of buildings
summary: Let $G$ be a closed type-preserving subgroup of the automorphism group of a thick locally finite building $X$ of finite rank, and assume that $G$ acts Weyl-transitively. We prove that every unitary representation of $G$ is mixing, unless its restriction to a parabolic subgroup of minimal non-spherical type is amenable in the sense of Bekka. It follows that every unitary representation of $G$ that is weakly contained in the regular representation, is mixing.
